title: Stairway to Forgotten Worlds
description: A woman in a long dark coat stands on a spiraling staircase, holding an ornate film reel device while reaching toward a large world map on the decaying wall. The stairs are painted with crashing ocean waves, surrounded by floating film strips, old photographs, and a ghostly translucent figure ascending into a beam of light from above.
prompt: A woman in a long grey coat stands on a decaying spiral staircase inside a circular room with a stained glass dome ceiling. She holds an ornate film reel apparatus and reaches toward a large vintage world map on the wall. The stairs are painted with turbulent ocean waves. Floating film strips, old photographs, and a translucent ghostly female figure ascending into a dramatic beam of light from above. Mysterious and surreal atmosphere with cinematic lighting.
